trigger_word_note: TRIGGER-WORD SPELLING (2026-08-18, W): training captions contain 'aavepyörä' 4724-7140 times and 'aavepyora' ZERO times, while every eval prompt asked for 'aavepyora'. Different strings to the text encoder, so every trig2/housestyle cell ever rendered asked a finetuned model for a token it never saw in training and got base-model noise back. The misspelled ids are KEPT VERBATIM rather than corrected in place: the whole historical board joins cells by prompt_id, so editing the text under an existing id would silently make old and new cells incomparable while looking identical. The correctly-spelled ids are ADDED alongside -- which also makes the pair the experiment: same model, same seed, one token spelled as trained and one as we have been testing. Seeds are deliberately IDENTICAL to the misspelled twin (trig2/trig2_uml both 1234) so the only variable between the pair is the spelling -- a different seed would confound the token with the sample and make the comparison worthless.
